function.name: diagnose_private_dns_trace
function.description: Correlates Resolve-DnsName wire traces, 168.63.129.16 recursive responses, Azure Resource Graph privateDnsZones, and Private Endpoint privateDnsZoneGroups to isolate split-brain DNS failure modes.

fqdn.description: Target Azure PaaS FQDN under diagnosis.

patterns.rootCause: A spoke subscription hosts a local privatelink.* Private DNS Zone linked to the spoke VNet, intercepting 168.63.129.16 queries before they reach the central Hub Private DNS Zone.
remediation: Delete or unlink the rogue spoke privatelink.* Private DNS Zone after exporting any valid A records.
Assign policies/deny-spoke-privatelink-zone.json at the Landing Zones management group scope with hubSubscriptionId excluded.
Verify Private Endpoint NIC privateDnsZoneGroup binds to the central Hub zone.
patterns.kqlHint: AzureDiagnostics | where Category == 'DnsQueryLogs' | where QueryName has 'privatelink' and ResponseCode == 'NXDOMAIN'

patterns.rootCause: The Private Endpoint was provisioned without a privateDnsZoneGroup resource, leaving the central Hub privatelink.* zone without an A record and causing 168.63.129.16 to fall back to the public CNAME.
remediation: Attach a privateDnsZoneGroup via Invoke-AzRestMethod targeting the central Hub Private DNS Zone.
Enforce policies/dine-central-dns-zone-group.json using a User-Assigned Managed Identity with Private DNS Zone Contributor on the Connectivity Hub.

patterns.rootCause: Azure DNS Private Resolver Outbound Ruleset forwards conditional domain queries to an unreachable or decommissioned on-premises DNS forwarder IP.
remediation: Inspect Outbound Endpoint subnet (172.16.1.64/28) NSG rules for UDP/TCP 53 egress.
Update the DNS Forwarding Ruleset target IP via Invoke-AzRestMethod and validate ExpressRoute/VPN BGP routes.
patterns.kqlHint: DNSInventory | where SubType == 'Forwarder' | summarize count() by Server, ResultCode

patterns.rootCause: Query traversed 168.63.129.16 and resolved the public PaaS CNAME to a public IPv4 address because the spoke VNet lacks a Virtual Network Link to the central Hub Private DNS Zone.
remediation: Create a Microsoft.Network/privateDnsZones/virtualNetworkLinks resource linking the spoke VNet to the Hub Private DNS Zone.
Flush negative/public DNS cache on the workload host and re-run Wait-PrivateDnsRecordConvergence.ps1.
patterns.kqlHint: VMConnection | where DestinationIp !startswith '10.' and DestinationIp !startswith '172.' and RemoteDnsCanonicalNames has 'privatelink'

patterns.rootCause: Azure wire-server 168.63.129.16 is serving a negatively cached NXDOMAIN response within the Private DNS Zone SOA minimum TTL window immediately following Private Endpoint creation.
remediation: Wait for SOA TTL expiry using Wait-PrivateDnsRecordConvergence.ps1 with exponential backoff.
Avoid issuing Resolve-DnsName pre-flight probes before privateDnsZoneGroup provisioning completes.
patterns.kqlHint: DnsEvents | where QueryType == 'A' and ResultCode == 3 | summarize count() by Name, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
